# `substr`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
substr(str, pos[, len])
```

Returns the substring of `str` that starts at `pos` and is of length `len`, or the slice of byte array that starts at `pos` and is of length `len`.

substr(str FROM pos[ FOR len]]) - Returns the substring of `str` that starts at `pos` and is of length `len`, or the slice of byte array that starts at `pos` and is of length `len`.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `string_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 1.5.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | [2, 3] |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- substr, example 1
> SELECT substr('Spark SQL', 5);
k SQL
```

```sql
-- substr, example 2
> SELECT substr('Spark SQL', -3);
SQL
```

```sql
-- substr, example 3
> SELECT substr('Spark SQL', 5, 1);
k
```

```sql
-- substr, example 4
> SELECT substr('Spark SQL' FROM 5);
k SQL
```

```sql
-- substr, example 5
> SELECT substr('Spark SQL' FROM -3);
SQL
```

```sql
-- substr, example 6
> SELECT substr('Spark SQL' FROM 5 FOR 1);
k
```

```sql
-- substr, example 7
> SELECT substr(encode('Spark SQL', 'utf-8'), 5);
k SQL
```
